mapper.select:
SELECT u.id, u.type, u.fullname, u.mobile, le.completion_status as completionStatus FROM user u LEFT JOIN learner_enrollment le ON u.id = le.user_id LEFT JOIN course c ON le.course_id = c.id WHERE u.type = 'LEARNER' and le.course_id = #{courseId} and c.is_in_progress = 1 ORDER BY ${pageUserReqDTO.orderBy} ${pageUserReqDTO.orderDirection}
LIMIT #{pageUserReqDTO.offset}, #{pageUserReqDTO.pageSize}
mapper.update: UPDATE classroom SET is_active = 0 WHERE id IN ( SELECT classroom_id FROM classroom_allocation WHERE course_id = #{page.coId} ) AND #{base.loginUserType} = 'ADMINISTRATOR'
mapper.delete: DELETE c FROM course c WHERE #{base.loginUserType} = 'ADMINISTRATOR' AND c.id = #{page.coId}
mapper.select: SELECT coId, coIsInProgress, coName, coNumberOfLearner, coStartDate, coEndDate, coTotalHours, coTotalDays, coDailyHours, coBreakTime, coLessonStartTime, coLessonEndTime, coLunchStartTime, coLunchEndTime, coCreatedAt, coUpdatedAt, coDeletedAt, coClassroomId, coClassroomName, coCourseHeadId, coInstructorId, coCourseHeadName, coInstructorName FROM ( SELECT co.id AS coId, co.is_in_progress AS coIsInProgress, co.name AS coName, co.number_of_learner AS coNumberOfLearner, co.start_date AS coStartDate, co.end_date AS coEndDate, co.total_hours AS coTotalHours, co.total_days AS coTotalDays, co.daily_hours AS coDailyHours, co.break_time AS coBreakTime, co.lesson_start_time AS coLessonStartTime, co.lesson_end_time AS coLessonEndTime, co.lunch_start_time AS coLunchStartTime, co.lunch_end_time AS coLunchEndTime, co.created_at AS coCreatedAt, co.updated_at AS coUpdatedAt, co.deleted_at AS coDeletedAt, cr.id AS coClassroomId, cr.name AS coClassroomName, MAX(CASE WHEN sd.position = 'COURSE_HEAD' THEN sa.user_id END) AS coCourseHeadId, MAX(CASE WHEN sd.position = 'FULLTIME_INSTRUCTOR' THEN sa.user_id END) AS coInstructorId, MAX(CASE WHEN sd.position = 'COURSE_HEAD' THEN us.fullname END) AS coCourseHeadName, MAX(CASE WHEN sd.position = 'FULLTIME_INSTRUCTOR' THEN us.fullname END) AS coInstructorName FROM course co LEFT JOIN staff_assignment sa ON co.id = sa.course_id LEFT JOIN user us ON sa.user_id = us.id LEFT JOIN staff_detail sd ON us.id = sd.user_id LEFT JOIN classroom_allocation ca ON ca.course_id = co.id LEFT JOIN classroom cr ON cr.id = ca.classroom_id GROUP BY co.id, co.is_in_progress, co.name, co.number_of_learner, co.start_date, co.end_date, co.total_hours, co.total_days, co.daily_hours, co.break_time, co.lesson_start_time, co.lesson_end_time, co.lunch_start_time, co.lunch_end_time, co.created_at, co.updated_at, co.deleted_at, cr.id, cr.name ) AS origin WHERE

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ( SELECT co.id AS coId, co.is_in_progress AS coIsInProgress, co.name AS coName, co.number_of_learner AS coNumberOfLearner, co.start_date AS coStartDate, co.end_date AS coEndDate, co.total_hours AS coTotalHours, co.total_days AS coTotalDays, co.daily_hours AS coDailyHours, co.break_time AS coBreakTime, co.lesson_start_time AS coLessonStartTime, co.lesson_end_time AS coLessonEndTime, co.lunch_start_time AS coLunchStartTime, co.lunch_end_time AS coLunchEndTime, co.created_at AS coCreatedAt, co.updated_at AS coUpdatedAt, co.deleted_at AS coDeletedAt, cr.id AS coClassroomId, cr.name AS coClassroomName, MAX(CASE WHEN sd.position = 'COURSE_HEAD' THEN sa.user_id END) AS coCourseHeadId, MAX(CASE WHEN sd.position = 'FULLTIME_INSTRUCTOR' THEN sa.user_id END) AS coInstructorId, MAX(CASE WHEN sd.position = 'COURSE_HEAD' THEN us.fullname END) AS coCourseHeadName, MAX(CASE WHEN sd.position = 'FULLTIME_INSTRUCTOR' THEN us.fullname END) AS coInstructorName FROM course co LEFT JOIN staff_assignment sa ON co.id = sa.course_id LEFT JOIN user us ON sa.user_id = us.id LEFT JOIN staff_detail sd ON us.id = sd.user_id LEFT JOIN classroom_allocation ca ON ca.course_id = co.id LEFT JOIN classroom cr ON cr.id = ca.classroom_id GROUP BY co.id, co.is_in_progress, co.name, co.number_of_learner, co.start_date, co.end_date, co.total_hours, co.total_days, co.daily_hours, co.break_time, co.lesson_start_time, co.lesson_end_time, co.lunch_start_time, co.lunch_end_time, co.created_at, co.updated_at, co.deleted_at, cr.id, cr.name ) AS origin WHERE

SELECT cu.id AS cuId, cu.course_id AS cuCourseId, cu.subject_order AS cuSubjectOrder, cu.name AS cuName, cu.hours AS cuHours, cu.textbook_name AS cuTextbookName, cu.textbook_author AS cuTextbookAuthor, cu.created_at AS cuCreatedAt, cu.updated_at AS cuUpdatedAt, cu.deleted_at AS cuDeletedAt FROM course_subject cu WHERE cu.course_id = #{coId} ORDER BY cu.subject_order ASC

SELECT cs.id AS csId, cs.subject_id AS csSubjectId, cs.course_id AS csCourseId, cs.class_date AS csClassDate, cs.period AS csPeriod, cs.period_start_time AS csPeriodStartTime, cs.period_end_time AS csPeriodEndTime, cs.created_at AS csCreatedAt, cs.updated_at AS csUpdatedAt, cs.deleted_at AS csDeletedAt FROM course_schedule cs WHERE cs.course_id = #{coId} ORDER BY cs.class_date ASC, cs.period ASC
SELECT DISTINCT cs.class_date AS csClassDate FROM course_schedule cs WHERE cs.course_id = #{coId} ORDER BY cs.class_date ASC, cs.period ASC
